title: analytics: the /analytics/sql dry run renders a time bucket over a text, select, number or boolean column, where the query refuses INVALID_FIELD
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Blocked-by: PR #28976 (same files)

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28852 dev (PR #28976, os-dev-report `6569764928`), measured on `main` while measuring the preview. The seat has not re-measured it. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: a dataset selection with a `timeDimensions` granularity over a member whose column is text, select, number or boolean:
- `/analytics/query` (native and ObjectQL) refuses it: the engine's temporal-bucket door answers `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 at `groupBy.N.dateGranularity`.
- After PR #28976, the draft preview refuses it the same way.
- The `/analytics/sql` dry run still renders a statement (`strftime` over the column) the query would refuse.

Same family as #28841 (PR #28878): the echo shows SQL for a selection the query refuses.

## Wanted

1. Measure the echo for the four column types, ObjectQL and cross-object.
2. If the echo renders where the query refuses, the echo refuses the same way, field for field, through the same reading PR #28976 adds (`preview-date-bucket-door.ts`), in the order `query()` refuses. ⛔ No new gate on the live faces, ⛔ no third copy of the refusal text.

This narrows the echo: a dry run that answers today is refused. So it is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, with a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review owed.

## Dedupe

Read open issues for `analytics sql strftime` and `"analytics/sql" dateGranularity`: only #28852 (the preview face). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`).

Links back: #28852, PR #28976, #28841, PR #28878
